trainer_start.packing_rule: micro_batches(lengths, micro_batch_tokens): greedy, order-preserving packs of <= budget tokens (a longer sequence is its own pack); the logprob and LoRA-gradient bits do not depend on the packing (batch-invariant forward, per-sequence gradient fold)

lora.form: unmerged: y = bf16(acc32(W x) + sum_k B[:,k] * bf16(A x)[k])
lora.grad_rule: per sequence: det_gemm dW rule over its tokens (T_pad = roundup(T, 256), 8 chunks of T_pad/8 rows, fp32 tree); step gradient = left fold in fp32 over the request's sequences in sample order, accumulated into the fp32 master .grad (packing- and TP-invariant)
